List of things I noticed, mostly small errors that can be fixed in a few minutes.
1. The title shows up as Scp 5334, it has to be SCP-5334.
2. Spelling errors, like in the first paragraph of the description in the middle it says "oh" instead of "of" and later you use "a" instead of "an"
3. Clinical tone, as in it isn't really present. Must be or should be is used instead of is to be, will stop instead of stops.
4. Imperial instead of Metric.
I might write a response to this talking about more major issues, but I don't have time right now and figured I might put down some small tone things

item.title: Re: Confusing and contradictory
item.content:encoded: Thank you for all this criticism. I see what you mean, and I will change it soon. The reason why SCP-5334 looks at Jupiter is in relation with another SCP I am working on called IO. As of 2, I explained it horribly, and I am working on that. As of 1 I will change the measurements. I will also fix number 3, because it is supposed to be dangerous. I don't know why I made it behave affectionately. These problems will be fixed later today. Thanks.

item.title: Confusing and contradictory
item.content:encoded:
1. Skips are supposed to use metric measurements; if imperial units are included at all, they should follow the metric units in parentheses. For instance: 2 meters (78 inches) long.
  2. Is this skip known to harm itself? "When inflicting harm upon SCP-5334, It would shoot out from the ball and into its target."
  3. Does it hate all other lifeforms and attempt instant kills, or does it behave affectionately to a few exceptions who can handle it safely?
  4. What biological features imply that #5334 evolved to live on a high-gravity gas giant, not a terrestrial planet? Gazing at Jupiter for no apparent reason seems bizarre.
